title: Medial Meniscus Versus MCL Injury

positions.as_written: Ask about mechanical symptoms, because catching, locking and a sense of something moving belong to the meniscus and not to the ligament.
Ask about the mechanism, since a valgus blow points at the ligament and a twisting injury on a loaded knee points at the meniscus.
- A knee too painful to examine should be recorded as that, not as a result.
